summary_en: This Phase 3 trial tests BNT324 against docetaxel with prednisone or prednisolone in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. BNT324 and docetaxel are given by intravenous infusion, and prednisone or prednisolone is taken by mouth; how often and for how long is not stated. The study measures radiographic progression-free survival and overall survival.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 3 compara BNT324 con docetaxel junto con prednisona o prednisolona en el cáncer de próstata metastásico resistente a la castración. BNT324 y docetaxel se administran por infusión intravenosa, y la prednisona o prednisolona se toma por vía oral; la frecuencia y la duración no se indican. El estudio mide la supervivencia libre de progresión radiográfica y la supervivencia global.
who_for: Adult men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer that has progressed.
Progression shown by rising PSA, soft tissue spread on imaging, or bone disease progression.
Prior treatment with one or two androgen receptor pathway inhibitors, with progression during or after at least 8 weeks.
No prior chemotherapy for metastatic castration-resistant disease, including taxane-based chemotherapy.
Castrate-level testosterone with ongoing hormone therapy or prior orchiectomy; ECOG performance score 0 or 1.
not_for: Prior treatment with B7-H3 targeted therapy, including B7-H3 antibody-drug conjugates.
Uncontrolled or significant cardiovascular disease, as defined in the protocol.
History of non-infectious interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis that needed steroids.
Current interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis.
Other protocol-defined criteria apply; details not stated.
